dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: Wait, she looks like... Is that Escoffier?

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: Escoffier's back? Yes! I've missed her cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: I was just saying, Hotel Debord is nothing without her...
